test_tfidf_retriever_multiworker: run the test_sparse_tfidf_multiworkers test to train and evaluate a TF-IDF retriever with 4 workers on bAbI task1k:1
test_tfidf_retriever_singlethread: run the test_sparse_tfidf_retriever_singlethread test to train and evaluate a TF-IDF retriever with 1 worker on bAbI task1k:1
test_tfidf_retriever_regexp: run the test_sparse_tfidf_retriever_regexp test to train and evaluate a TF-IDF retriever using the regexp tokenizer on bAbI task1k:1
train_tfidf_retriever_model: train a tfidf_retriever model on the bAbI task1k:1 dataset using testing_utils.train_model with configurable workers and tokenizer
load_and_query_tfidf_agent: load a trained TF-IDF retriever agent from a model file using create_agent_from_model_file and query it with agent.observe and agent.act
